title: Unreal C++ Essentials
description: Learn introductory C++ through Unreal Engine types, conventions and gameplay-focused examples.
overview: This focused course introduces the C++ syntax and Unreal Engine concepts needed to read and modify small gameplay classes. It is an engine-oriented starting point rather than a complete treatment of standard C++. Programming Foundations I is recommended for complete beginners.
